verdict.rationale: Shared docs and notes are a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never shows Jira itself letting users create or organize docs or notes. The only related items point to Confluence, a separate Atlassian product that customers add on, and to Rovo pulling in Confluence assets. That is an integration with another product, not Jira's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
